rationale: Two independent 2026 contamination papers reach this from opposite ends. The mitigation side proves it: the field's metric is |under-suppression minus over-suppression| while the honest one is their sum, so cancellation alone reaches zero. Measured, LNE-blocking's over-suppression is 2.0x RailCap's yet its aggregate reading is 3.8x better, and a synthetic strategy that makes the model fail every question outscores two published methods. Correcting the readout and the aggregation order reverses the published ranking outright. The detection side makes the adjacent claim: a null audit is uninterpretable without the efficacy, budget and validity gates that produced it, and 9 of 9 gate-passing channels fail the budget the field's own planner prescribes. In both cases the statistic was inherited rather than derived, and in both it flattered the method under test.
statement: A summary statistic that nets opposing errors before reporting them can be satisfied by damage rather than by repair, so its zero point certifies nothing about any individual item.
